snippet.title: Garden and a Goat - Official Demo Trailer | Demo Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
The Demo is live now on Steam! In preparation for Steam Next Fest, we've created this public, focused preview. Wishlist now to stay connected and we'll keep you updated on early access later this year!

Wishlist on Steam at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156550/Garden_and_a_Goat/

Join our Discord to chat with the team and players following the game (link on the Steam page).

Garden and a Goat is a single-player animal collecting and ecosystem recovery game! You play as a friendly robot, eager to help a series of ecosystems in need. Clean up the environment, revive plants, and entice the local wildlife to return, unlocking ever more animals and decorations along the way!

#IndieGames #SteamNextFest #CozyGaming #CozyGames #AnimalGames #SteamDemo #GardenAndAGoat
